notes: v2beta services take multipart forms and, under Accept: application/json, return one base64 image with its finish reason. The model selects the service: stable-image-ultra, stable-image-core, an sd3.5 model, or stable-image-inpaint for edits. GET /v1/user/balance proves a key without cost. Errors carry id, name and errors. A 403 named content_moderation is the caller's content, not a credential failure.
